6	A live run is refused outside 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. Eastern, the window the Max plan allows.
7	A named person can lift the window with --window-lifted-by; the record then carries who and when.
8	"""
9	import argparse
10	import datetime
11	import json
12	import pathlib
13	import socket
14	import sys
15	import threading
16	import time
17	import zoneinfo

19	from cosa.repo.symindex import build, dups, spec as sp
20	from cosa.repo.symindex.candidates import candidate_stage, vector_build, vector_store
21	from lupin_mcp.reuse_needset import draft, keys, pool, quota, run, strip
22	from lupin_mcp.reuse_needset import errors as er

24	EASTERN      = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo( "America/New_York" )
25	WINDOW_START = 10
26	WINDOW_END   = 13
27	TOTAL        = 10
28	MATCHED      = 8
29	NONE         = 2
30	SECOND_MODEL = "claude-opus-5-5"
31	SECOND_SYSTEM = "You answer with one JSON object and nothing else."
32	SMOKE_FILE   = "needset-smoke.json"
33	SMOKE_FORMAT = "needset-smoke-1"

36	def in_window( now ):
37	    """
38	    Say whether a moment falls in the hours a live model run is allowed.
39	
40	    Requires:
41	        - now is a timezone-aware datetime
42	
43	    Ensures:
44	        - True from 10:00 up to, not including, 13:00 Eastern time, on any day
45	
46	    Raises:
47	        - ValueError when now has no timezone
48	    """
49	    if now.tzinfo is None: raise ValueError( "now must carry a timezone" )
50	    return WINDOW_START <= now.astimezone( EASTERN ).hour < WINDOW_END

53	def parse_args( argv ):
54	    """
55	    Read the command line.
56	
57	    Ensures:
58	        - the root, out dir, source commit, seed, vector folders and the three matched-kind counts are required
59	        - the kind split is whatever is passed; no default stands in for the real split
60	        - window_lifted_by is None unless the caller names who lifted the window and when
61	    """
62	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser( description=__doc__ )
63	    ap.add_argument( "--root",             required=True )
64	    ap.add_argument( "--out-dir",          required=True )
65	    ap.add_argument( "--source-commit",    required=True )
66	    ap.add_argument( "--seed",             required=True, type=int )
67	    ap.add_argument( "--vectors-dir",      required=True )

69	    ap.add_argument( "--near-copy",        required=True, type=int )

73	    ap.add_argument( "--parallel",         type=int, default=3 )
74	    ap.add_argument( "--server",           default="max-plan" )
75	    ap.add_argument( "--set-by",           default="smoke" )
76	    ap.add_argument( "--cli-path",         default=None )

82	def kind_split( args ):

87	class Timed:
88	    """Times every model call and counts the ones that raise, by the label of the model."""
89	
90	    def __init__( self, clock ):
91	        """Read the time from clock(); calls holds ( label, seconds, failed ) rows."""
92	        self.clock, self.calls, self.lock = clock, [], threading.Lock()
93	
94	    def wrap( self, label, ask ):
95	        """Return ask with each call timed under label; the reply or the error passes through."""
96	        def timed( *args ):
97	            """Forward the call, recording its duration and whether it raised."""
98	            start, failed = self.clock(), True
99	            try:
100	                reply  = ask( *args )
101	                failed = False
102	                return reply
103	            finally:
104	                with self.lock: self.calls.append( ( label, self.clock() - start, failed ) )
105	        return timed
106	
107	    def summary( self, label=None ):
108	        """
109	        Summarise the calls of one label, or of all.
110	
111	        Ensures:
112	            - returns { calls, errors, seconds } where seconds is { mean, min, max } or None with no call
113	        """
114	        rows = [ c for c in self.calls if label is None or c[ 0 ] == label ]
115	        secs = [ c[ 1 ] for c in rows ]
116	        return { "calls": len( rows ), "errors": sum( 1 for c in rows if c[ 2 ] ), "seconds": { "mean": sum( secs ) / len( secs ), "min": min( secs ), "max": max( secs ) } if secs else None }

119	def index_parts( root, index_dir ):
120	    """
121	    Build the index of a tree and everything the run reads from it.
122	
123	    Requires:
124	        - root is a repository root and index_dir a folder to publish the index in
125	
126	    Ensures:
127	        - returns ( by_id, kept, measures, twins, bodies ) with by_id holding every searchable record
128	        - twin ids are the index's own ids, which carry no prefix in the lupin tree
129	    Raises:
130	        - NeedsetError NOT_LUPIN_TREE when root lacks the lupin layout
131	    """
132	    root    = pathlib.Path( root )
133	    if not build.is_lupin_tree( root ): raise er.NeedsetError( er.NOT_LUPIN_TREE, f"{root}: the strip step resolves ids of the lupin layout only" )
134	    built   = build.build( root, index_dir )
135	    records, _reader = pool.read_pool_symbols( built[ "gen_dir" ] )
136	    measures = pool.measure( root, records )
137	    kept, _dropped = pool.eligible( records, measures )
138	    spec    = sp.spec_for( root )
139	    found   = dups.find_duplicates( spec, sp.iter_files( spec, spec.py_roots, { ".py" } ), js_files=sp.iter_files( spec, spec.js_roots, set( sp.SCRIPT_SUFFIXES ) ) )
140	    twins   = pool.twin_map( found )
141	    return { r[ "id" ]: r for r in records }, kept, measures, twins, strip.bodies_for( kept, root )
142

144	def candidate_parts( vectors_dir, cache_dir, client, records ):
145	    """
146	    Load the live vector set and build the word stage and the query embedder.
147	
148	    Requires:
149	        - vectors_dir holds a sealed vector set; client has embed( texts, content_type, role ) and info()
150	
151	    Ensures:
152	        - returns ( vectors, stage, embed ) where embed( text ) is the concat query vector of that text
153	    """
154	    vectors = vector_store.load_vectors( vectors_dir )
155	    stage   = candidate_stage.build_stage( records )
156	    embed   = lambda text: vector_store.query_vectors( text, client, cache_dir, vectors.manifest )[ "concat" ]
157	    return vectors, stage, embed

160	def assemble_env( args, ask, second_ask, client, set_at, timed ):
161	    """
162	    Put the index, the candidate parts and the model calls into a run.Env.
163	
164	    Requires:
165	        - ask( system, user ) and second_ask( system, user ) return reply text; client is an embeddings client
166	        - timed is a Timed, and both models are called through it, under the labels draft and second
167	
168	    Ensures:
169	        - the env is a smoke env, with its two ledgers under args.out_dir
170	        - the seed pool is the eligible symbols that have a row in the vector set, and the counts are kept in env.extras
171	        - a symbol newer than the vector set is left out, so the smoke measures; the real draw needs a fresh vector set
172	    """
173	    root, out = pathlib.Path( args.root ), pathlib.Path( args.out_dir )
174	    by_id, kept, measures, twins, bodies = index_parts( root, out / "index" )
175	    vectors, stage, embed = candidate_parts( args.vectors_dir, args.query_cache_dir, client, list( by_id.values() ) )
176	    rows    = set( vectors.ids )
177	    pooled  = [ r for r in kept if r[ "id" ] in rows ]
178	    extras  = { "vector_coverage": { "eligible": len( kept ), "with_a_vector_row": len( pooled ), "vector_set_ids": len( rows ), "stage_ids": len( stage.ids ) } }
179	    book    = draft.SharedLedger( draft.make_ledger( out / "ledger-draft.jsonl", args.cli_path, args.server ) )
180	    second  = draft.SharedLedger( draft.make_ledger( out / "ledger-second.jsonl", args.cli_path, args.server ) )
181	    second_timed = timed.wrap( "second", second_ask )
182	    describe = lambda i: f"{by_id[ i ][ 'sig' ]} — {by_id[ i ][ 'doc' ]}"
183	    none_fn = draft.make_none_drafter( stage, vectors, embed, describe, lambda prompt: second_timed( SECOND_SYSTEM, prompt ), second, args.second_model )
184	    ctx     = keys.KeyContext( pooled, measures, bodies, args.seed, vectors )
185	    return run.Env( by_id, pooled, ctx, twins, lambda rec: strip.strip_member( rec, root ), timed.wrap( "draft", ask ), book, draft.DRAFTER_MODEL, args.server, args.source_commit,
186	                    args.seed, kind_split( args ), args.set_by, set_at, none_draft_fn=none_fn, parallel=args.parallel, smoke=True, extras=extras )
187

189	def live_build_env( args, set_at, timed ):
190	    """Build the env with the real drafter, the real second model and the real embeddings client."""
191	    return assemble_env( args, draft.drafter_call(), draft.drafter_call( args.second_model ), vector_build.EndpointClient(), set_at, timed )

194	def lifted_by( args ):
195	    """
196	    Return who lifted the time window, or None when nobody did.
197	
198	    Requires:
199	        - args is the parsed command line
200	
201	    Ensures:
202	        - returns the stripped text of --window-lifted-by; blank text counts as nobody
203	    """
204	    named = "" if args.window_lifted_by is None else args.window_lifted_by.strip()
205	    return named if named else None

208	def smoke_report( args, timed, result, started, finished, host, extras ):
209	    """
210	    Summarise one smoke run as measurements.
211	
212	    Ensures:
213	        - returns the date, host, source commit, split, seed, extras, and the calls of both models: totals, errors, seconds per call and the same for each model
214	        - failure_rate is the failed seeds over the seeds tried, with failed seeds listed by reason
215	        - says in a note that it is a measurement and not a pass bar
216	    """
217	    cells  = result[ "cells" ]
218	    failed = [ f for c in cells for f in c[ "failed" ] ]
219	    tried  = sum( len( c[ "accepted" ] ) for c in cells ) + len( failed )
220	    total  = timed.summary()
221	    reasons = {}
222	    for f in failed: reasons[ f[ "reason" ] ] = reasons.get( f[ "reason" ], 0 ) + 1
223	    return { "format": SMOKE_FORMAT, "smoke": True, "date": finished.isoformat(), "host": host, "source_commit": args.source_commit, "seed": args.seed,
224	             "kind_split": kind_split( args ), "ts_share": args.ts_share, "needs": len( result[ "needs" ] ), "model_calls": total[ "calls" ], "call_errors": total[ "errors" ],
225	             "seconds_per_call": total[ "seconds" ], "by_model": { label: timed.summary( label ) for label in ( "draft", "second" ) },
226	             "seeds_tried": tried, "seeds_failed": len( failed ), "failure_rate": len( failed ) / tried if tried else None, "failed_by_reason": reasons,
227	             "window_lifted_by": lifted_by( args ),
228	             "elapsed_seconds": ( finished - started ).total_seconds(), "extras": extras, "note": "a measurement, not a pass bar" }
229	
230	
231	def main( argv=None, build_env=None, now=None, clock=time.monotonic, host=None ):
232	    """
233	    Run the smoke: refuse a live run outside the window, then draft ten needs and measure.
234	
235	    Requires:
236	        - build_env( args, set_at, timed ) returns a run.Env whose model calls go through timed.wrap; None means the live env
237	        - now is a function returning an aware datetime, None for the system clock
238	
239	    Ensures:
240	        - returns the smoke report, also written as needset-smoke.json beside the plan, drafts and draft report
241	        - every need carries smoke true, and the calls of the drafter and the second model are timed apart
242	        - the window is checked before anything is built or called, and only for the live env
243	        - a live run outside the window goes ahead only when --window-lifted-by names a person
244	
245	    Raises:
246	        - NeedsetError OUTSIDE_WINDOW for a live run at another time
247	        - NeedsetError KIND_SPLIT_UNSET or QUOTA_INVALID from the split the arguments name
248	    """
249	    args  = parse_args( argv )
250	    now   = ( lambda: datetime.datetime.now( datetime.timezone.utc ) ) if now is None else now
251	    live  = build_env is None
252	    start = now()
253	    if live and lifted_by( args ) is None and not in_window( start ): raise er.NeedsetError( er.OUTSIDE_WINDOW, start.astimezone( EASTERN ).isoformat() )
254	    table = quota.plan_quota( TOTAL, MATCHED, NONE, args.ts_share, kind_split( args ) )
255	    pathlib.Path( args.out_dir ).mkdir( parents=True, exist_ok=True )
256	    timed = Timed( clock )
257	    env   = ( live_build_env if live else build_env )( args, start.isoformat(), timed )
258	    env.smoke = True
259	    result = run.run_needset( env, table, args.out_dir )
260	    report = smoke_report( args, timed, result, start, now(), socket.gethostname() if host is None else host, env.extras )
261	    ( pathlib.Path( args.out_dir ) / SMOKE_FILE ).write_text( json.dumps( report, sort_keys=True, indent=4 ) + "\n", encoding="utf-8" )
262	    return report
263	
264	
265	if __name__ == "__main__":
266	    print( json.dumps( main(), indent=4 ) )
267	    sys.exit( 0 )

"""
The ten-need drafting smoke: a small live run that measures and sets no pass bar.

It takes a test-only kind split and a named commit as arguments and marks every need smoke.
It writes the date, host, commit, seconds per call and failure rate beside the drafts.
A live run is refused outside 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. Eastern, the window the Max plan allows.
A named person can lift the window with --window-lifted-by; the record then carries who and when.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import json
import pathlib
import socket
import sys
import threading
import time
import zoneinfo

from cosa.repo.symindex import build, dups, spec as sp
from cosa.repo.symindex.candidates import candidate_stage, vector_build, vector_store
from lupin_mcp.reuse_needset import draft, keys, pool, quota, run, strip
from lupin_mcp.reuse_needset import errors as er

EASTERN      = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo( "America/New_York" )
WINDOW_START = 10
WINDOW_END   = 13
TOTAL        = 10
MATCHED      = 8
NONE         = 2
SECOND_MODEL = "claude-opus-5-5"
SECOND_SYSTEM = "You answer with one JSON object and nothing else."
SMOKE_FILE   = "needset-smoke.json"
SMOKE_FORMAT = "needset-smoke-1"


def in_window( now ):
    """
    Say whether a moment falls in the hours a live model run is allowed.

    Requires:
        - now is a timezone-aware datetime

    Ensures:
        - True from 10:00 up to, not including, 13:00 Eastern time, on any day

    Raises:
        - ValueError when now has no timezone
    """
    if now.tzinfo is None: raise ValueError( "now must carry a timezone" )
    return WINDOW_START <= now.astimezone( EASTERN ).hour < WINDOW_END


def parse_args( argv ):
    """
    Read the command line.

    Ensures:
        - the root, out dir, source commit, seed, vector folders and the three matched-kind counts are required
        - the kind split is whatever is passed; no default stands in for the real split
        - window_lifted_by is None unless the caller names who lifted the window and when
    """
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser( description=__doc__ )
    ap.add_argument( "--root",             required=True )
    ap.add_argument( "--out-dir",          required=True )
    ap.add_argument( "--source-commit",    required=True )
    ap.add_argument( "--seed",             required=True, type=int )
    ap.add_argument( "--vectors-dir",      required=True )
    ap.add_argument( "--query-cache-dir",  required=True )
    ap.add_argument( "--near-copy",        required=True, type=int )
    ap.add_argument( "--work-alike",       required=True, type=int )
    ap.add_argument( "--cross-language",   required=True, type=int )
    ap.add_argument( "--ts-share",         type=float, default=0.6 )
    ap.add_argument( "--parallel",         type=int, default=3 )
    ap.add_argument( "--server",           default="max-plan" )
    ap.add_argument( "--set-by",           default="smoke" )
    ap.add_argument( "--cli-path",         default=None )
    ap.add_argument( "--second-model",     default=SECOND_MODEL )
    ap.add_argument( "--window-lifted-by", default=None )
    return ap.parse_args( argv )


def kind_split( args ):
    """Return the matched-kind split the arguments name."""
    return { "near_copy": args.near_copy, "work_alike": args.work_alike, "cross_language": args.cross_language }


class Timed:
    """Times every model call and counts the ones that raise, by the label of the model."""

    def __init__( self, clock ):
        """Read the time from clock(); calls holds ( label, seconds, failed ) rows."""
        self.clock, self.calls, self.lock = clock, [], threading.Lock()

    def wrap( self, label, ask ):
        """Return ask with each call timed under label; the reply or the error passes through."""
        def timed( *args ):
            """Forward the call, recording its duration and whether it raised."""
            start, failed = self.clock(), True
            try:
                reply  = ask( *args )
                failed = False
                return reply
            finally:
                with self.lock: self.calls.append( ( label, self.clock() - start, failed ) )
        return timed

    def summary( self, label=None ):
        """
        Summarise the calls of one label, or of all.

        Ensures:
            - returns { calls, errors, seconds } where seconds is { mean, min, max } or None with no call
        """
        rows = [ c for c in self.calls if label is None or c[ 0 ] == label ]
        secs = [ c[ 1 ] for c in rows ]
        return { "calls": len( rows ), "errors": sum( 1 for c in rows if c[ 2 ] ), "seconds": { "mean": sum( secs ) / len( secs ), "min": min( secs ), "max": max( secs ) } if secs else None }


def index_parts( root, index_dir ):
    """
    Build the index of a tree and everything the run reads from it.

    Requires:
        - root is a repository root and index_dir a folder to publish the index in

    Ensures:
        - returns ( by_id, kept, measures, twins, bodies ) with by_id holding every searchable record
        - twin ids are the index's own ids, which carry no prefix in the lupin tree
    Raises:
        - NeedsetError NOT_LUPIN_TREE when root lacks the lupin layout
    """
    root    = pathlib.Path( root )
    if not build.is_lupin_tree( root ): raise er.NeedsetError( er.NOT_LUPIN_TREE, f"{root}: the strip step resolves ids of the lupin layout only" )
    built   = build.build( root, index_dir )
    records, _reader = pool.read_pool_symbols( built[ "gen_dir" ] )
    measures = pool.measure( root, records )
    kept, _dropped = pool.eligible( records, measures )
    spec    = sp.spec_for( root )
    found   = dups.find_duplicates( spec, sp.iter_files( spec, spec.py_roots, { ".py" } ), js_files=sp.iter_files( spec, spec.js_roots, set( sp.SCRIPT_SUFFIXES ) ) )
    twins   = pool.twin_map( found )
    return { r[ "id" ]: r for r in records }, kept, measures, twins, strip.bodies_for( kept, root )


def candidate_parts( vectors_dir, cache_dir, client, records ):
    """
    Load the live vector set and build the word stage and the query embedder.

    Requires:
        - vectors_dir holds a sealed vector set; client has embed( texts, content_type, role ) and info()

    Ensures:
        - returns ( vectors, stage, embed ) where embed( text ) is the concat query vector of that text
    """
    vectors = vector_store.load_vectors( vectors_dir )
    stage   = candidate_stage.build_stage( records )
    embed   = lambda text: vector_store.query_vectors( text, client, cache_dir, vectors.manifest )[ "concat" ]
    return vectors, stage, embed


def assemble_env( args, ask, second_ask, client, set_at, timed ):
    """
    Put the index, the candidate parts and the model calls into a run.Env.

    Requires:
        - ask( system, user ) and second_ask( system, user ) return reply text; client is an embeddings client
        - timed is a Timed, and both models are called through it, under the labels draft and second

    Ensures:
        - the env is a smoke env, with its two ledgers under args.out_dir
        - the seed pool is the eligible symbols that have a row in the vector set, and the counts are kept in env.extras
        - a symbol newer than the vector set is left out, so the smoke measures; the real draw needs a fresh vector set
    """
    root, out = pathlib.Path( args.root ), pathlib.Path( args.out_dir )
    by_id, kept, measures, twins, bodies = index_parts( root, out / "index" )
    vectors, stage, embed = candidate_parts( args.vectors_dir, args.query_cache_dir, client, list( by_id.values() ) )
    rows    = set( vectors.ids )
    pooled  = [ r for r in kept if r[ "id" ] in rows ]
    extras  = { "vector_coverage": { "eligible": len( kept ), "with_a_vector_row": len( pooled ), "vector_set_ids": len( rows ), "stage_ids": len( stage.ids ) } }
    book    = draft.SharedLedger( draft.make_ledger( out / "ledger-draft.jsonl", args.cli_path, args.server ) )
    second  = draft.SharedLedger( draft.make_ledger( out / "ledger-second.jsonl", args.cli_path, args.server ) )
    second_timed = timed.wrap( "second", second_ask )
    describe = lambda i: f"{by_id[ i ][ 'sig' ]} — {by_id[ i ][ 'doc' ]}"
    none_fn = draft.make_none_drafter( stage, vectors, embed, describe, lambda prompt: second_timed( SECOND_SYSTEM, prompt ), second, args.second_model )
    ctx     = keys.KeyContext( pooled, measures, bodies, args.seed, vectors )
    return run.Env( by_id, pooled, ctx, twins, lambda rec: strip.strip_member( rec, root ), timed.wrap( "draft", ask ), book, draft.DRAFTER_MODEL, args.server, args.source_commit,
                    args.seed, kind_split( args ), args.set_by, set_at, none_draft_fn=none_fn, parallel=args.parallel, smoke=True, extras=extras )


def live_build_env( args, set_at, timed ):
    """Build the env with the real drafter, the real second model and the real embeddings client."""
    return assemble_env( args, draft.drafter_call(), draft.drafter_call( args.second_model ), vector_build.EndpointClient(), set_at, timed )


def lifted_by( args ):
    """
    Return who lifted the time window, or None when nobody did.

    Requires:
        - args is the parsed command line

    Ensures:
        - returns the stripped text of --window-lifted-by; blank text counts as nobody
    """
    named = "" if args.window_lifted_by is None else args.window_lifted_by.strip()
    return named if named else None


def smoke_report( args, timed, result, started, finished, host, extras ):
    """
    Summarise one smoke run as measurements.

    Ensures:
        - returns the date, host, source commit, split, seed, extras, and the calls of both models: totals, errors, seconds per call and the same for each model
        - failure_rate is the failed seeds over the seeds tried, with failed seeds listed by reason
        - says in a note that it is a measurement and not a pass bar
    """
    cells  = result[ "cells" ]
    failed = [ f for c in cells for f in c[ "failed" ] ]
    tried  = sum( len( c[ "accepted" ] ) for c in cells ) + len( failed )
    total  = timed.summary()
    reasons = {}
    for f in failed: reasons[ f[ "reason" ] ] = reasons.get( f[ "reason" ], 0 ) + 1
    return { "format": SMOKE_FORMAT, "smoke": True, "date": finished.isoformat(), "host": host, "source_commit": args.source_commit, "seed": args.seed,
             "kind_split": kind_split( args ), "ts_share": args.ts_share, "needs": len( result[ "needs" ] ), "model_calls": total[ "calls" ], "call_errors": total[ "errors" ],
             "seconds_per_call": total[ "seconds" ], "by_model": { label: timed.summary( label ) for label in ( "draft", "second" ) },
             "seeds_tried": tried, "seeds_failed": len( failed ), "failure_rate": len( failed ) / tried if tried else None, "failed_by_reason": reasons,
             "window_lifted_by": lifted_by( args ),
             "elapsed_seconds": ( finished - started ).total_seconds(), "extras": extras, "note": "a measurement, not a pass bar" }


def main( argv=None, build_env=None, now=None, clock=time.monotonic, host=None ):
    """
    Run the smoke: refuse a live run outside the window, then draft ten needs and measure.

    Requires:
        - build_env( args, set_at, timed ) returns a run.Env whose model calls go through timed.wrap; None means the live env
        - now is a function returning an aware datetime, None for the system clock

    Ensures:
        - returns the smoke report, also written as needset-smoke.json beside the plan, drafts and draft report
        - every need carries smoke true, and the calls of the drafter and the second model are timed apart
        - the window is checked before anything is built or called, and only for the live env
        - a live run outside the window goes ahead only when --window-lifted-by names a person

    Raises:
        - NeedsetError OUTSIDE_WINDOW for a live run at another time
        - NeedsetError KIND_SPLIT_UNSET or QUOTA_INVALID from the split the arguments name
    """
    args  = parse_args( argv )
    now   = ( lambda: datetime.datetime.now( datetime.timezone.utc ) ) if now is None else now
    live  = build_env is None
    start = now()
    if live and lifted_by( args ) is None and not in_window( start ): raise er.NeedsetError( er.OUTSIDE_WINDOW, start.astimezone( EASTERN ).isoformat() )
    table = quota.plan_quota( TOTAL, MATCHED, NONE, args.ts_share, kind_split( args ) )
    pathlib.Path( args.out_dir ).mkdir( parents=True, exist_ok=True )
    timed = Timed( clock )
    env   = ( live_build_env if live else build_env )( args, start.isoformat(), timed )
    env.smoke = True
    result = run.run_needset( env, table, args.out_dir )
    report = smoke_report( args, timed, result, start, now(), socket.gethostname() if host is None else host, env.extras )
    ( pathlib.Path( args.out_dir ) / SMOKE_FILE ).write_text( json.dumps( report, sort_keys=True, indent=4 ) + "\n", encoding="utf-8" )
    return report


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print( json.dumps( main(), indent=4 ) )
    sys.exit( 0 )
